dedupe_keys.name: porto electric dial a ride and local energy community benchmark instances

description: This Zenodo deposit supplies twenty electric autonomous dial-a-ride benchmark instances coupled to two local energy communities in metropolitan Porto, Portugal. The Polytechnic of Porto team derived passenger requests from taxi trips and used road-network travel times alongside quarter-hourly community loads, photovoltaic production, batteries, tariffs and grid limits. Instances vary from two to twenty vehicles and twenty to 200 requests, with time-of-use and flat-price cases. The public CC BY 4.0 release includes instance and optimization-output archives, an energy workbook, a README and Python and Julia generation scripts. Coverage is a constructed benchmark for one metropolitan setting, not observed operation of an autonomous fleet or deployed charging network. Demand sampling, assumed charging and tariff rules limit interpretation as measured travel service. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing routing and charging optimization under local grid constraints. data-openstreetmap is related because the generator extracts a Porto road network through OSMnx; exact network revision was not verified. A round-one candidate rejected this as lacking transport infrastructure, but the current file inventory explicitly includes road times and energy constraints. No archive or script was downloaded.
